01 / The standard

Fewer shortcuts.
Better clothes.

You have standards.
So should your clothes.

NEWST is for men who notice the difference. The feel of a fabric. The line of a shoulder. The way a garment sits.

We believe the things worth owning should be worth keeping. That belief shapes our brief, from the first choice of cloth to the final fit approval.

The difference is in the detail

01 / The cloth

Substance you can feel.

Fabric is the starting point. Our Collection 001 brief calls for 220–240gsm cotton for the Foundation Tee, approximately 400gsm loopback for the Foundry Crew and 450gsm for the Standard Hoodie. Each piece has its own weight, structure and character.

02 / The fit

Shape with intention.

Clean shoulders. Controlled proportions. Room where it is needed. From the fitted Foundation Tee to the straight-taper Workshop Denim, every piece has a defined silhouette and a fit brief to meet.

03 / The finish

Every detail earns its place.

Considered collars, cuffs and seams. Discreet branding. A shaped hood without dangling drawstrings. Details chosen to serve the garment and the person wearing it.

Before it carries our name

A standard set.
A standard checked.

Our release standard requires physical fit approval, agreed materials and colour swatches, wash and construction checks, and a signed-off pre-production sample before bulk production.

Sampling is where the decisions must prove themselves. Collection 001 is being developed against that brief.

We set the brief.
We answer for the result.

Accountability, close to home

Birmingham is where our standard starts. Our ambition is to cut, sew and finish every NEWST garment in the city that shaped us.
